policy: A template is production-ready only when legal provenance, originality, renderer safety, multilingual typography and premium/WOW quality all pass. Source-authored code alone is not enough.
hardGates: all fonts and component assets APPROVED
no portfolio concentration or near-duplicate-family warning
designPrinciples: typography and emotional hierarchy before ornament
personalization should influence composition where appropriate
avoid generic gradients, sparkles, confetti and black/gold luxury shorthand
avoid cultural/city names as aesthetic stereotypes
procedural geometry is preferred over third-party decorative assets
one clear signature move per family
photo use is optional/creative unless objectively required
